summary: UiPath filed an 8-K reporting Q1 FY2027 financial results (revenue $418M, +17% YoY; ARR $1.901B, +12% YoY) and disclosed that CEO Daniel Dines adopted a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to sell up to 2.975M shares (<5% of his holdings) through Oct 14, 2026 for personal tax and liquidity reasons. This is a routine earnings release and insider trading plan disclosure, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative event is announced. The filing is purely informational with no deal terms or strategic action requiring classification.
